blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Advocacy groups are urging regulators to distribute more than 55,000 excess Move It riders among other motorcycle taxi platforms to protect their livelihoods after the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) imposed a P555.75-million penalty on the company for exceeding its authorized rider allocation. Move It was authorized to operate with 17,746 rider-partners in Metro Manila but was found to have exceeded the limit by more than 55,000 riders. The LTFRB imposed a P10,000 fine for each excess rider, resulting in a total penalty of P555.75 million. Move It has since filed a motion for reconsideration seeking […]...
